interpretation.explicitVsKeyword: Target membership is based on explicit record identity, not broad keyword classification.
interpretation.permanentPickups: The six permanent pickup families and their three apparent level variants are treated as a resource structure. Their exact gameplay values and stacking semantics remain to be interpreted from the resolved fields.
interpretation.bridgePowerups: The four normal bridge Powerup records are treated as the explicit temporary Powerup family.
interpretation.goldenIdol: Golden Idol/statue support records are retained separately because the world object, acquisition ability, pickup entity and global Idol parameters may each carry different parts of the mechanic.
interpretation.sinnersSacrifice: Sinner records are source-support records only in this checkpoint; no reward equivalence to Golden Statue acquisition is assumed.
interpretation.finalGoal: Validated world-buff effects will later become inputs to PlayerState(t), alongside hero progression, category investment and owned items.
